title: Ollama
content:
[Cloud models](https://ollama.com/blog/cloud-models) are now available in Ollama

**Chat & build with open models**

[Download](https://ollama.com/download) [Explore models](https://ollama.com/models)

Available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Ollama is the easiest way to get up and running with large language models.
